source: Euratlas Periodis 1300 (Nüssli), maps viewed on euratlas.net, sampled at place centres
method: Identity from the 245 per-entity maps (one shared frame; red outline = held in sovereignty, green outline/tint = held as a dependency), filled to area masks (ray-parity inside test; colour fill checked by parity where outlines failed). Sovereign = smallest sovereign mask covering the pixel, dependent = smallest dependent mask (or a sovereign holding the land under another, e.g. England in Gascony). Geometry: the four quarter maps are 0.59x crops of the entity frame (offsets measured by colour matching); 55 city dots measured on the quarters give the entity-frame fit. Each place is sampled in the entity frame (3x3 majority) and on the quarter and regional maps (flat-colour segment of the place, labelled by entity-mask majority); weighted vote. confidence = vote share x local agreement; -1 = outside Euratlas coverage or unmapped (desert/white).
